AwLxrRrYye8.name: Do You Want To Own Distribution?
AwLxrRrYye8.speaker: Emrah Bayraktar, co-founder of Vision Clipping
paragraphs: If you're a brand with content, or even just the ability to make it, I can turn it into traffic that actually lands on your website. Not views, traffic. Here's proof from some campaigns we're running right now. Firstly, in the last 30 days, we did over 13.7 million views with them, and we 4x their website traffic. They tripled what they were paying us after the first month. Nobody triples their spend on something that isn't working. Second, one of the biggest names in the world hired us to run his distribution.

We only started three accounts from absolutely zero and did over 5.1 million views in less than 2 weeks. Third case study, we geotargeted a client's content so tightly that 71 to 89% of the people watching were in the exact countries that they sell to. Almost nobody else can promise that. And this isn't just me. Between my co-founder Jaden and I, we've done content for some of the biggest names and brands in completely different industries, covered in Forbes, ABC, and National Public Radio. And from my own experience before all of this, I posted a single clip that put over 20,000 leads into a client's funnel in less than a week.

So, none of what I'm talking about is guesswork. Now, here's the part that almost nobody is talking about. You're probably doing fine right now with your content, and that's exactly the trap. Content used to be the moat. Whoever made the best quality content won. But, I don't know if you realize, but AI just ended that. Everyone can make good content now at basically no cost. So, making it isn't the edge anymore. Getting it in front of the right people every single day on channels you own, that's the edge.

And almost nobody has that yet. And that's the window. Right now, you can be the first in your markets to own distribution at this scale. Whoever moves now compounds an audience nobody catches later because you can't out-post someone who started 2 years before you. The old way, renting reach, renting new views through either mass clipping campaigns or paying for advertisements, those two are the blockbusters in all of this. It looks fine right up until the day it doesn't. And I'll be completely honest here. We only run this for one brand per market.

So, in your space, this is a chair, not a subscription. Once your competitor sitting in it, that window shut for you. That's not a sales line, it's just how we protect the clients we take. So, here's what we built. A network of social media accounts that belong to you, that we run for you, posting every single day. Not some random clippers their accounts, yours. You keep every single account and every single follower. Every post we make is a test. We try different hooks, formats, CTAs, and we track one single thing.

Did this video convert? We track what actually drives traffic to your website, and we kill what doesn't. And we run the winners across all accounts. So, it gets better every single week instead of just louder. Here's how your first 90 days with us would look like. We run four channels for you. A channel is four accounts. TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook. 16 accounts in total. We run these accounts on dedicated physical devices. This way they behave like real accounts and don't get flagged. But, I know you don't care about how we do what we do.

You care about actually getting conversions from your offer. You want people from the exact countries that you're selling to watching your videos and actually buying what you're selling. Am I wrong? You're getting 480 posts a month geo-targeted to the exact countries that you're selling to. Every single video is reviewed by our team before it goes out there. And you might wonder why I say 90 days. That's the minimum. These accounts need time to warm up, time to prepare, and the algorithm needs to learn who your buyer is.

Anyone promising you results in a couple of weeks is selling you a spike, not a machine. We are building you an asset. Oh, I don't have enough content. Most brands think that and they are wrong. One podcast, one interview, just your phone and an hour of content is enough to get started. And if your brand starting from scratch, we'll handle the creative direction and build the content with you. Your niche is too boring? We've run this model across completely different industries, and boring niches often win because nobody else is bothering to show up.

Oh, I've seen clipping flop because quite frankly everyone is running on the old model where you have a bunch of freelance clippers posting on accounts that you don't own. Of course it's going to flop. It's a different model and it'll get you different results. Oh, but what if I end up with 16 dead accounts? These accounts are yours and you can watch every single day what is being uploaded, how much you're getting, who's taking an actionable step from which accounts. All the data is yours. Okay, so I'm going to be completely honest here.

One thing has to be true for us to be able to work together. You're already spending more than five figures a month on content marketing. This is for brands who are serious, not someone just testing the waters. If you've already got a content library, a podcast, a long-form video, we distribute it. If you don't, we'll build it with you. Either way, the money and the intent have to be real. One last thing before you book the call. Because of how sure I am that this works, here's my guarantee.

From day one, you'll see traffic in your own dashboard with attribution showing directly which pages people are taking action on. And if in the first 30 days of us working together, you do not see qualified traffic sent to your website, people taking an actionable step, we'll keep it running at no cost until we do. I only make money when it works. That's how I've always operated. So, if you want to be the one who owns your market distribution instead of watching your competitor do it first, book a call.
We'll look at what you've got and tell you straight to your face whether the window is still open in your space.

Rpt5F6w_Vpk.name: Music Clipping Overview | Vision Clipping
Rpt5F6w_Vpk.speaker: Jaden Malcolm, co-founder of Vision Clipping
paragraphs: Hello, my name's Jaden, co-founder of Vision Clipping. In this short video, I'm going to quickly go over our music content distribution offer. As you know, in the music industry, you need to get your song around everywhere as much as possible. Getting your music into trends, getting people to make videos about your music, and we've kind of found the best way to do this at scale is to implement your music in trending formats. So, you've probably seen on your feed, you know, different football edits including different songs.

You'll be actually quite surprised how many of those are placements. At the minute, there's not a reliable scalable way to get your content in those videos. Paid promotion is not the best thing. You're always having to deal with the next random person. There's not necessarily any consistency. What we've done is essentially productize this into an offer where you can get your music into these trending formats. The way we engineer these clips and the different calls actions we use is for the purpose of people to easily be able to see your music and go to your Spotify etc. streaming platforms and start listening to your music.

Just by this content being in front of lots of people, this can easily start to spark trends of people using the music. So, for example, these are a few past cases of how UK records have broken through obviously TikTok social platforms and whatnot. We have Nemzzz, "Elevate". This song was heavily heavily used in edits. Central Cee, "Doja", again, heavily used in edits, and then that started a chain reaction to be a big hit. So, for some quick context, I'm the co-founder, Jaden. I've spent a lot of time in content and whatnot.

As a company, we've got just over about 3 billion views in total. And this is my co-founder, Emrah. He is one of the top guys in the clipping industry, very well known for working with some of the world's biggest creators. Also featured in Forbes, New York Times, NPR, and lots of different publications regarding clipping and content distribution. And this is David, which is Deluxe. You may have actually seen on your feed. David is a very close partner with us in this operation. He's obviously got his own content creation career.

Also, he's very tapped into the UK music space. And yes, we've also worked with some of the world's biggest names such as Red Bull, LEGO, and FaZe, and a huge catalog of some of the biggest business people and brands in the world. And some of our very relevant work to this whole music content distribution operation, we've actually produced content for Sexyy Red, NLE Choppa, and also JoJo Siwa. So, how does this exactly work? We are running a network of fully owned pages by ourselves. So, what we'll do is we'll take your music, we'll create edits, and then we'll deploy those edits across the pages that we fully own and fully run.

We operate in seven niches. At the minute, only two niches have slots available because we've been quite full. But, the two that are open are football edits and news and culture posts. And these are probably the best two niches to actually get into at the minute just because the viral potential. Football's never going out of trend, and news and culture and cultural relevance is never going to go out of trend as well. So, let's move on to all the different packages that we offer. So, the minimum package starts at £1,000 a month.

From that, you'll get 90 posts a month using your music in videos that we produce. That is split across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. And with that, we'll be promoting one song. You have the option to choose up to two niches. So, going back before, uh we typically run seven different niches. At the minute, you know, there's only slots available for two. So, obviously in this, you could decide I want all 90 posts to be on football edits, or do I want all 90 posts to be on news and culture edits, or, you know, maybe you want to split.

And how this works is you may be wondering where these being posted. We own a network of accounts that we own as a company, and we distribute the content produced across the account network that we own. And now, this is the standard package. So, the standard package is £3,000 a month, and what you'll be getting is obviously increase in videos produced to 300. With this package, you now have the option of promoting two songs with the amount of posts. So, for example, that could be 150 posts with one song, then 150 posts of another song.

Just to add, if you do want to deploy more than, say, the one or two songs that we offer in these packages, we do offer add-ons, which I will get on to you later about how to add more songs and a bunch of other things as well. And with this, you have up to three niches you can deploy your posts across. And now onto the higher tier packages. So, the premium package is slightly different from the prior one. This is at £5,000 a month. What you'll be getting is 300 posts on our pages that we own, which is essentially the same as the prior offer.

But now, on top of this, we're going to be running three extra social media pages that is just about you. And you're not going to be featured on a page with other people's music on. It's going to be three dedicated pages just for your music. And on those pages, you'll be having 90 total posts. 30 Instagram, 30 TikTok, and 30 YouTube. As you know, social media accounts take time to grow. But at the same time, you've got 300 posts that are going to be deployed on existing warm pages that already have maybe some form of following.

So, basically, in the time that your brand new accounts are warming up and getting into the algorithm, you've already got posts being deployed on a page that's already warm and in the algorithm at the same time. And now, we've got the elite package, which is the top package before we start going into bespoke custom offers specifically for you. With this, we're going to be giving you 450 posts on our pages, 270 posts on accounts that you own, and you're going to be owning nine accounts if you work with us or not, basically.

And with this offer, you can deploy seven songs across all of the posts. And a major benefit of the premium and the elite package is you can actually use your promotional material, such as music videos, any promo content, and whatnot. Up to 1 hour, you can send it to us, and we can then deploy those on the pages that we're running for you. Okay, brilliant. So, now these are the add-ons. So, what we offer at £400 a month is a live dashboard. And basically, what that is is a live dashboard where you can see all of the posts, all the analytics, all the views in one place.

And on top of that, you can see the Spotify streams of that particular song. This is a highly recommended option so you don't have to manually go find and track all the views that our posts are getting for you. And the next offer is a featured lander spot. Across all of the accounts that we run, we have a link in bio which is basically a list of featured music and a person can easily go on the link and click your song and it will take them straight to Spotify.

And for 250 pound a month, you can basically have your song on there. And if you're the highest spender for this lander option, we'll put your song right at the top. So by default, all of these accounts are targeting a UK audience, but we do have the option to add geos. Let's say you want to target a US audience or a Portuguese audience or a Spanish audience. We have the technology to basically target where these videos are deployed and they end up. And this is going to be an extra 150 pound a month on your plan.

But this is only possible on accounts that you own. So this is only available for the premium package and the elite package. And now the pre-release hold for 500 pound a month. So let's imagine your newest single is going to drop in two weeks time or for example, it's going to drop on Friday. We'll get the MP3 of your song before the release date, create a big bank of edits and basically on the release date, we can start distributing the content straight away. So from release date, you're going to have content being consistently pushed out of your new single or your new track.

Because this is operationally changing what we do, we charge 500 pound a month for this benefit. And now for what I was mentioning earlier, we charge an extra 200 pound a month if you want to deploy an extra song in the month. So let's say you're on the standard package and you have one song. If you want those 90 posts to be deployed across two songs instead of one, it's an extra 200 pound a month. So then you'll have 45 posts or so on one song and then you'll have 45 posts on another.

And now the last add-on is the mid-month song change. So now let's say you're on the standard package where you can only promote one song. With this mid-month song change for 150 pounds, you can change it to essentially a different song. And you can change the song as many times you want. Every single time it's going to be a 150 pound charge. And also just to add on the premium and the elite packages, the live dashboard is included in the price. So you do not have to pay anything extra for that.

And also on top of that, on the accounts that you own, you'll have full control of whatever's in the link in bio. So, what do we need from you? Two things. One, the song. You will have to send us an MP3 or WAV file of the song or a link to maybe the YouTube video or the Spotify link, so we can actually have access to the song and we can assess if this is going to be a right fit for the verticals and content types that we are going to do for you.

Number two, if applicable, the Instagram, TikTok, and also YouTube sound link. So, usually in the right corner, you'll have a sound link to the actual track. We do need the link for that, so we can link it to all the videos that we produce for you. And then now, only for the premium and the elite packages, your promotional material. And that could be sent in Google Drive, WeTransfer, anything similar, and that's up to 1 hour of content. And finally, just to end it off, you do not need to build a production team, we already have.

We think this is going to be far, far easier and cheaper for you as music artists to get your music out there. So, please message us, go to our website, book a call, it would be a pleasure to get you on board.
